spirit__root.title: Soul Burst
spirit__root.description: Unlocks Soul Burst (Level 3) (43 mana, 42.75 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__root.extra_description: Release a soul fire explosion at the caster position, damaging and burning souls of targets caught inside The first skill of the Spirit base.

spirit__planned_night_parade.title: Hyakki Yagyo
spirit__planned_night_parade.description: Unlocks Hyakki Yagyo (55 mana, 25 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__planned_night_parade.extra_description: A short night parade of yokai sweeps forward through your enemies, soulburning and weakening everything it passes.

spirit__revenant_of_honor.title: Revenant of Honor
spirit__revenant_of_honor.description: Unlocks Revenant of Honor (Level 2) (83 mana, 228 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__revenant_of_honor.extra_description: Summon a loyal Spirit Samurai to protect you from threats

spirit__mana_shield.title: Mana Shield
spirit__mana_shield.description: Teaches Mana Shield, an Epic Fight Guard skill: Damage taken is paid for with mana, in proportion to the hit against your max health. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

spirit__spirit_empowerment.title: Spirit Empowerment
spirit__spirit_empowerment.description: Unlocks Spirit Empowerment (Level 3) (72 mana, 57 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__spirit_empowerment.extra_description: Applies Spirit Empowerment to yourself, granting Spirit Spell Power bonus.

spirit__spirit_challenging.title: Spirit Challenging
spirit__spirit_challenging.description: Unlocks Spirit Challenging (Level 3) (76 mana, 114 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__spirit_challenging.extra_description: Extracting a part of target soul and then start the challenging. The soul can be attacked and an amount of the damage it took will be transferred to its owner.

spirit__kitsune_pack.title: Kitsune Pack
spirit__kitsune_pack.description: Unlocks Kitsune Pack (Level 3) (43 mana, 171 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__kitsune_pack.extra_description: Summon a pack of Kitsune that will fight for you, inflict soulburn effect on their bite

spirit__soul_protection.title: Soul Protection
spirit__soul_protection.description: Teaches Soul Protection, an Epic Fight Guard skill: You cannot guard; your soul gives 20% damage negation and every second summons a soul worth 1% more; each hit taken removes 3 souls. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

spirit__grave_sigil.title: Grave Sigil
spirit__grave_sigil.description: Unlocks Grave Sigil (Level 3) (40 mana, 25.65 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__grave_sigil.extra_description: Marks a grave sigil on the ground, then detonates it in two soul-charged waves: first a cross, then an X of spectral eruptions.

spirit__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
spirit__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

spirit__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
spirit__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

spirit__spiral_of_ruin.title: Spiral of Ruin
spirit__spiral_of_ruin.description: Unlocks Spiral of Ruin (Level 3) (42 mana, 28.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
spirit__spiral_of_ruin.extra_description: Hurls a spectral trident that unfurls a telegraphed spiral of soul eruptions from its point of impact.

spirit__ashigaru_squad.title: Ashigaru Squad

spirit__bone_hands.extra_description: Summon Spirit Bone Hands from the ground, the hands will slam your targets if they are in range

spirit__planned_soul_lantern.title: Soul Lantern

spirit__planned_soul_lantern.extra_description: A pale soul lantern drifts to the target and bursts in soul fire, applying soulburn.
